entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: A plane once covered in a shroud of perpetual darkness, cursed by Prince Velrav.

entities.name: Velrav
entities.description: Youngest of King Gelidor's three sons; exiled, learned black magic, massacred his family and cursed Diraden with Eternal Night; beheaded by Chandra.

entities.name: King Gelidor
entities.description: King of Diraden who exiled Velrav; impaled himself on the sword that killed his son, ending the curse.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed Velrav on Diraden.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spark Velrav tried to absorb.

entities.name: Velrav Castle
entities.description: Where Prince Velrav resided and brought captured residents.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: Curse cast by Velrav cloaking Diraden in darkness and cutting it off from non-black mana.

events.summary: King Gelidor exiles his youngest son Velrav, who learns black magic from the most powerful demon and takes revenge.
events.quote: After King Gelidor exiled the Prince Velrav , the youngest of his three sons

events.summary: Velrav massacres his family, feeds on the king and erects a curtain of darkness over the world.
events.quote: He massacred the entire family and fed on the king

events.summary: Velrav casts a curse on Diraden, cloaking it in Eternal Night and cutting it off from non-black mana.
events.quote: cutting the plane off from non- black mana

events.summary: Chandra and Gideon are taken to the Prince's palace, where Velrav tries to absorb Gideon's spark.
events.quote: During a ritual where Velrav attempted to absorb Gideon's planeswalker spark

events.summary: Chandra regains her red mana and beheads Velrav with a flaming sword.
events.quote: she beheaded the prince with a flaming sword

events.summary: King Gelidor impales himself on the same sword, ending the curse; Chandra and Gideon leave.
events.quote: King Gelidor then impaled himself on the same sword, ending the plane's curse.

relations.quote: she beheaded the prince with a flaming sword
